feedback: I cannot log in after the latest app update. The OTP screen keeps loading and never sends the code.
Payment was deducted from my card but the app still says the transaction failed.
The app crashes whenever I tap on my profile page.
I tried resetting my password, but the reset link expired immediately.
My booking confirmation did not appear in the app even though I received an SMS.
The chatbot keeps giving irrelevant answers when I ask about refund status.
The app is very slow when loading my account history.
I uploaded a document, but the status still says pending upload.
The notification settings do not save after I turn off marketing alerts.
I was charged twice for the same subscription renewal.
The map inside the app shows the wrong service centre location.
Face verification failed repeatedly even though my camera works fine.
I cannot update my phone number because the save button is greyed out.
The app logged me out in the middle of submitting a form and I lost all my progress.
My voucher disappeared from the rewards page after I clicked redeem.
I get an error message saying service unavailable every time I open the dashboard.
The search function does not return relevant results for nearby services.
My appointment was cancelled in the app but I did not receive any explanation.
The app keeps asking me to verify my email even though I already did it yesterday.
The live chat queue resets when I switch away from the app.

Dear support team, I am writing because I have been unable to access my account since yesterday evening. After entering my email and password, the app asks for an OTP but no code arrives. Please assist as I need to complete a booking today.

Hi, I submitted a payment through the app this morning and the money was deducted from my bank account. However, my order status still shows unpaid. Could you check whether the transaction went through?
Hello, I tried to upload my supporting documents three times, but each upload failed at the final step. The files are PDF and below the size limit shown in the app.
Dear team, the app keeps crashing whenever I open the messages tab. I have already reinstalled the app and restarted my phone but the issue continues.
Hi, I would like to report that my appointment details are missing from the mobile app. I received an email confirmation, but nothing appears under upcoming appointments.
Hello, I requested a refund last week but the app still shows the case as new. Could someone update me on the expected processing time?
Dear support, I accidentally selected the wrong service category and cannot edit my submitted request. Please advise whether I should cancel and submit a new one.
Hi, the app interface is confusing when trying to change notification preferences. I turned off promotional messages, but I am still receiving them daily.
Hello, I am unable to redeem the reward voucher in my account. The app says it has already been used, but I have not used it before.
Dear team, the map directions in the app sent me to the wrong building. Please update the location pin for the service centre at the central branch.
Hi, I completed identity verification but the app still shows my status as unverified. This prevents me from accessing several services.
Hello, my subscription renewed twice this month and I see two separate charges. Please help reverse the duplicate payment.
Dear support team, the chatbot does not understand my question about changing my booking date. It keeps redirecting me to unrelated FAQ pages.
Hi, I tried using the search bar to find nearby service centres, but it shows results that are very far away from my postal code.
Hello, I lost all information entered into a long form after the app timed out. It would be helpful if drafts were saved automatically.
The app is generally useful, but the login process takes too many steps and OTP delivery is inconsistent.
I like the clean layout and the booking flow was easy to understand.
Payment confirmation is unclear. I was not sure whether my transaction succeeded until much later.
The search results could be improved because I often cannot find the correct service on the first try.
The app loads quickly and I appreciate having all my requests in one place.
The chatbot was not helpful for complex questions, but the human support follow-up was good.
I found the document upload process frustrating because error messages were too vague.
Notifications are timely and useful, especially appointment reminders.
The rewards section is confusing and does not clearly explain redemption rules.
I had no major issues, but the app could provide clearer progress tracking for submitted requests.
The app crashed twice while I was editing my profile, which made the experience unreliable.
The interface is simple enough for everyday use, but some labels are unclear.
I prefer the app over calling support because it saves time.
The location feature sometimes recommends service centres that are not actually nearby.
The overall experience is acceptable, but I would like automatic draft saving for long forms.
